$description: Motion tokens (DTCG). Durations + easing curves for component transitions. Added 2026-06-19 from the Tabs fitness test (Route A) — first motion tokens in the store; reference these from component `motion` blocks rather than hard-coding timings. Reduced-motion handling is a component rule, not a token.

standard.$description: primary moving elements (e.g. tab selected-indicator slide)

press.$description: tactile/scale-physics press depress — snappy, no overshoot (ease-out). Added 2026-06-22 with Button Refined scale-physics.

spring.$description: scale-physics grow toward cursor + release; pairs with easing/spring overshoot. Added 2026-06-22.

travel.$description: Press-physics TRAVEL — total px of size change per interaction step, applied as scale(calc(1 ± travel/control-size)) so movement is PIXEL-TRUE at every control size (B-D7, Dave 2026-07-22: the Icon-button size-scoped model propagates family-wide; supersedes Button's proportional 1.04/0.95). Unitless number of px. THEME DIAL: Legacy + Supercharge override to 0 — movement absent, state feedback is colour-only; Mono + Console keep 2. Consumed via the component-type tier (component-type/button-family/press-travel).

darken.$description: Press-physics DARKEN — filter:brightness() factor on :active (B-D7: the Icon-button value 0.94 propagates, superseding Button's 0.85). THEME DIAL: Legacy + Supercharge override to 1 (no darken). Unitless.

spring.$description: overshoot for scale-physics grow/settle (Button Refined; promoted 2026-06-22). Use sparingly — see _MOTION-THEMES.md theme 2 (Settle).

out.$description: CSS ease-out — snappy press release, pairs with duration/press
